verdict.rationale: ZCode documents autonomous multi-step Goal execution with planning and verification. It also documents remote triggering via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram. However, nothing shows a cloud-hosted agent that builds, tests, and produces a demo of a feature for review. The agent runs locally as a desktop, web or TUI app, or over SSH/WSL, so the Goal workflow and chat-app wake-up are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review
